name: Mohican Adventures Campground
evidence: Campspot park map + OSIP/Esri at 40.6185,-82.2578: nightly back-in 101 (40 ft) pad ~18 m from the bank over open grass, lane behind it, 102 ~30 m; tagged 'Lake Front' 301-304 sit across the park road, so view only. Water ~240x90 m (~2 ha), so pond despite operator's 'Lake'. FAQ: no riverfront RV sites; river cabins don't count.

name: Jackson Lake State Park
evidence: OSIP leaf-off + Esri at 38.9032,-82.5955 with ReserveOhio facility 851 per-site plot: drive-in back-ins 10-14, 26, 27 ~50-75 m from shore through a continuous wooded band even leaf-off, no sightline; nearer sites 4-8, 28-32 are walk-ins and don't count.

name: Perry Township Park
evidence: OSIP + Esri at 41.7958,-81.1614 with Campspot map (schematic, placement estimated): nightly Transient 33/31 pads ~55-60 m from the Lake Erie retaining wall across open lawn, garage and drive partly in line, open NNE sightline: view, not on-water. Campspot 'Lakeview' tag only on primitive 22-23 (15-20 ft) and tents 24-25, not counted.

name: Streetsboro / Cleveland SE KOA Holiday
evidence: KOA site map + OSIP at 41.2432,-81.3875: nightly full-hookup 1-5 on the north bank of 'Catch & Release' pond, pad ends ~10-25 m from the bank over open mown lawn with the lane behind them. Water ~95x100 m (~0.8 ha), NE water ~60x80 m; operator calls both ponds. Pond, not lake.

name: Ridge Ranch Campground
evidence: ResNexus base map draws 142-156 and 157-173 on the shore; OSIP at 41.2305,-80.9825 shows rigs ~5-15 m from the water, lane behind. Named '$3750/$4000 Seasonal Site' but the engine sells them nightly: 2027 quotes 142-147, 155 at $112 (Aug 6-8), 142-153 at $79 (May 18). Not seasonal-only. Plain RV sites 1-26, 81-101 inland.

name: Stonelick State Park
evidence: OSIP + Esri at 39.2190,-84.0605 with ReserveOhio facility 559 per-site plot: premium electric 029 (41 ft, web-bookable back-in) ~25-30 m from shore across open grass beside a dock, no road between (cul-de-sac on its south side). 028 ~55 m, 030 behind the loop road, 024-027 behind a wooded belt. On-water at 029 only.

name: RiverView Kampground
evidence: OSIP leaf-off + Esri at 39.77142,-81.90086: nearest rigs ~25 m from the Muskingum bank with the park's riverside lane between them and the water, rest of the rows ~40-100 m; view through a broken line of bank trees. Lane in the way means view at best. No per-site map (operator site is a landing page); the 'riverfront seasonal' claim was another park's.

name: Lake Hope State Park
evidence: OSIP leaf-off at 39.3400,-82.3440 and 39.3375,-82.3430 with ReserveOhio facilities 492+493 per-site plot (192 sites): all along a forest road in a wooded hollow north/east of the lake head; nearest 001 ~210 m from the marshy creek, ~380 m from open water, 184 ~315 m, through full forest over a ridge; no view. 'Lakefront sites 1-49 & 148-192' was a facility name.
